free_tier.stated: VIP1 (free on registration): 500 GB+ storage — 120 GB on signup plus 380 GB for registering the partner app — with +100 GB per invited user, '扩容无上限' (unlimited expansion). Per-file 5 GB on VIP1.

retention.stated: VIP2 (1.5 TB+, 10 GB/file) and VIP3 (3 TB+, 20 GB/file) are earned via points from the partner shopping app, not purchased. Storage is 'permanent' while the account stays active

egress.terms: No speed limit and no traffic quota at any tier: '不限速，永久免费'. Downloads are free of charge and unmetered.

tooling: WebDAV is listed as 公测中 (public beta) on VIP1 and supported on VIP3; offline download also beta. No documented REST API.
chaining: 500 GB base + 100 GB per invited account is a genuinely linear free multiplier, and the operator states there is no ceiling on expansion. Chain = 100 GB x N invites, capped only by the invite funnel.

reliability_note: The entire free-storage economy is a shopping-rebate funnel — capacity is denominated in invites and points from a third-party app, so the 'unlimited expansion' depends on a partner business that can disappear. WebDAV is still beta on the free tier.
